title: NASA reveals 16 stunning galaxies hiding cosmic chaos
caption:
NASA’s latest gallery of 16 galaxies reveals the violent forces shaping our universe. Using X-ray data from Chandra alongside Webb and Hubble, astronomers can see black hole jets and galactic collisions in unprecedented detail.

Source: Sciencedaily - NASA reveals 16 stunning galaxies hiding cosmic chaos

https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/10/261018205050.htm

Written in our own words. Credit for the research belongs to the study authors and their institution.
